name: How I Became a Pokémon Card

description.text:
How I Became a Pokémon Card (ポケモンカードになったワケ) is a manga series by Kagemaru Himeno, one of the card game's illustrators, in six volumes from 1999 to 2001. Each chapter tells the story behind one of her card illustrations, and each volume came with a card she drew for it, in a paper envelope mounted inside the book.

Volume 1 (May 1999) came with Mankey, volume 2 (September 1999) with Psyduck, volume 3 (January 2000) with Jynx, volume 4 (August 2000) with Sunkern, volume 5 (July 2001) with Hoppip, and volume 6 (September 2001) with the birthday Pikachu, "_____'s Pikachu", whose chapter is "Akari and Pikachu's Birthday". The first five carry the series' mark, a small card on an open book, in place of a set symbol; the Pikachu does not.
